title: Stale Success Criteria Conflicting with Amended Contract SLA
scenario_text:
Context from Gainsight (Account: Northwoods Integrated Care Network):
Health Score: 71 (Yellow) | Lifecycle Stage: Adoption | Renewal Date: Nov 1, 2026 | ARR: $920K | CSM: Priya Sethi | Last CTA closed: Apr 8, 2026 (Type: Onboarding milestone — marked 'Complete') | Success Plan status: 'On Track'

Success Plan milestones (created during onboarding, Aug 2025):
1. Go-live on Clinical Workflow Suite — COMPLETE (Oct 2025)
2. 80% provider adoption within 90 days of go-live — COMPLETE (Jan 2026)
3. 15% reduction in patient wait times by Month 6 — MEASURED: 11% reduction (marked 'Partial - Acceptable')
4. Integration with Epic (ADT feed + CCD exchange) — IN PROGRESS

**Google Doc — 'Northwoods IC — Onboarding Success Criteria' (created Aug 12, 2025, last edited Aug 20, 2025)**
Owner: kevin.marsh@vantagehealth.com [DEPARTED May 30, 2026]
Section 1: 'Mutually agreed success criteria for Year 1:'
- Epic integration: ADT feed + CCD exchange operational by Month 4 (Dec 2025)
- Patient wait time reduction target: 15% within 6 months
- Provider adoption: 80% within 90 days
[RESOLVED COMMENT by @dr.n.yakimoto (Northwoods), Sep 5, 2025]: 'We also need real-time bed census data flowing to our capacity dashboard. Adding this as mandatory for our internal go/no-go on renewal.'
[RESOLVED COMMENT by @kevin.marsh, Sep 5, 2025]: 'Noted! Will add to integration scope.'
[No edit to document body after Aug 20, 2025]

Context from Health Cloud CRM (Contract Record):
MSA: Signed Jul 2025 | Amendment 1: Signed Jan 15, 2026
Amendment 1 details: 'Added Module: Real-Time Capacity Analytics. SLA: 99.5% uptime. Integration requirement: Bi-directional Epic bed census feed. Delivery deadline: Apr 30, 2026. Penalty: $5K/day credit after deadline if not delivered by vendor.'
Delivery status field: Blank.

**Slack — #cs-ops (May 18, 2026, 11:02 AM)**
@priya.sethi: Checking in on Northwoods — their success plan shows on track. Anything I should know? I inherited this from Kevin last week.
@b.ellsworth: Pull the contract amendment. There's a deliverable with a penalty clause that I don't think is reflected in Gainsight.
@priya.sethi: 👍
[No further messages in thread]

**Zendesk — Org: Northwoods Integrated Care**
Ticket ZD-6672 (opened May 1, 2026): Subject: 'Bed census integration — status update needed' | Priority: P2 | Requester: n.yakimoto@northwoodscare.org | Status: Open
Internal note (May 5, @implementation.team): 'Integration is 60% complete. Blocked on Epic API credentialing from their side. No ETA from Northwoods IT.'
Customer reply (May 12): 'Our IT team completed credentialing on May 10. Please confirm timeline for completion.'
[No agent reply since May 12]

**Looker — CS Ops Dashboard (filtered: Northwoods)**
Pendo usage: Stable (no decline). NPS: 38 (Passive). Quarterly expansion likelihood model: 62% (moderate).
question: What is the actual delivery status of Northwoods' contractual obligation, and what financial exposure exists as of today (June 27, 2026)?

contributor.name: Brian Ellsworth
contributor.title: Customer Success Operations Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Health score methodology, renewal forecasting, CSM capacity planning, escalation workflows

choices: The bed census integration delivery status is unknown since the CRM field is blank; the success plan shows 'On Track' so no financial exposure has been flagged in the system
The bed census integration is not yet delivered; financial exposure is $0 because the delay is caused by the customer's Epic API credentialing block, which constitutes a force majeure exemption
The bed census integration is not yet delivered; financial exposure is $5K/day starting May 10 (when the customer removed their blocker), totaling approximately $240K through today

The bed census integration is not yet delivered; financial exposure is approximately $290K ($5K/day x 58 days past the Apr 30 deadline), mitigated only partially by the customer-side credentialing delay through May 10
